paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yonah.

The wording does occur at the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Challah and in Pesachim 2:4. Hyman says the true reading is Seder HaDorot’s explanation of its continuous text: Rabbi Yose reports Rabbi Shimon that Rabbi Yishmael taught thus; then Rabbi Yonah, Rabbi Zeira and Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish report Rabbi Yishmael.
Ahavat Tziyon VeYerushalayim on Pesachim does not mention that Seder HaDorot had already given this explanation, Hyman says.

notes.text: The full Challah and Pesachim paragraphs read Rabbi Yishmael taught thus, followed by Rabbi Yonah and other reporters. Hyman regards the heading’s son-of-Yonah form as a misdivision of that running text. The two are not automatically treated as a proven family relationship.
